name: status-mark

frames.best_why: Four rows carry green ticks and the last shows a running arc, covering every status at once.

tagline: Task rows whose status icons go from dashed ring to progress arc to green tick.
summary: A compact agent-run checklist where each task row carries a small status glyph: a dashed ring while pending, a filling arc while running, and a green tick when done.
appearance: A dark rounded card headed AGENT RUN stacks five task rows. Each row starts with a small circular glyph and grey text; completed rows show a solid green circle with a tick and lighter text.
behaviour: As each task moves from pending to running its dashed ring thickens into a rotating progress arc, then closes into a filled green circle whose tick is drawn on.
demo_content: Agent run tasks: Read the repository, Plan the migration, Update 14 call sites, Run the test suite, Open a pull request.
search_phrases: task status icon that morphs to a check
ring that fills into a tick
ai task list with status dots
use_when: A task list or agent run log needs a tiny, legible status per row that changes over time.
avoid_when: The glyph is only 20px, so it needs a text label beside it; alone its meaning is not obvious.
customise: Status, progress, label, four colours, size, stroke width, dash count, spin speed, arc length and draw time are props.
weight_why: A tiny SVG with motion values; the spin runs only while a task is running.

a11y.note: Each glyph exposes a spoken status through an image role or a hidden prefix, and the spin falls back under reduced motion.

issues: The pending dashed ring and running arc look similar at 20px, so the difference is easy to miss.
polish_why: The morph from dashed ring to arc to tick is precise and reads well in a dense list.
title: Status Mark
